prompt: Round 3 of 4. The researcher side proposes (We propose university ownership with an option to licence, which protects our ability to publish and build on method

content.text:
The university wants uni_owns_option_to_licence and 30-day review. We want company ownership and 60-day review. I can trade: accept uni_owns_option_to_licence (move from contract_research_company_owns) but push review back to 60 days, or accept 30 days but keep company ownership. 

Since we're in round 3 of 4, I need to make a meaningful move. Our hard interest is getting usable results - an option to licence works if we can exercise it. Let me accept uni_owns_option_to_licence but negotiate publication review back to 60 days since we handle confidential municipal client data.
So I'll concede on IP ownership, accepting their option-to-licence term, while holding firm on pushing the review period back up to 60 days.
